geometry.model: Ideal no-slip crossed-roller bearing; geometry-bound kinematics, not recovered CAD mates or a contact/load simulation
geometry.innerRacePolicy: Part 59 rests on the fixed front/back plate; source manual step 11 and matching inner mounting pattern.
geometry.outerRacePolicy: Part 69 follows the output outer-ring support; source manual steps 6, 7 and 11. Both outer-race halves are represented by one source occurrence and are never split synthetically.
geometry.cagePolicy: Part 62 follows cage angle. Exactly 66 original source rollers per side orbit with the cage and spin about their measured alternating 45-degree axes.
limitations: 10-micrometre source rolling clearance is neglected for ideal no-slip motion.
The imported bearing is source-triangulated AP242 geometry, not an analytic solid/contact model.
No elastic deformation, preload, lubrication, slip, force, collision or load-life calculation.
Support rings are excluded from this rig and belong to the gearbox output motion owner.
